University of Texas Rio Grande Valley
Student Policies
The Student Policies Publication provides general information about the university and contains rules that affect undergraduate and graduate students (excluding medical school and podiatry). The Student Policies Publication should be used along with the undergraduate and graduate catalogs. In certain sections of the Student Policies Publication, an overview of the policy or procedure or general information may be provided along with a link to more detailed information on the University website or other policy documents.
Undergraduate Catalog
The UTRGV Undergraduate Catalog provides information about degrees offered by the departments within each college. The section for each college describes the degree requirements for all majors (including concentrations), minors, and certificates offered by the college. A list of undergraduate courses and a glossary of terms are also included.
Graduate Catalog
The UTRGV Graduate Catalog provides information about degrees offered by the departments within each college. The section for each college describes the degree requirements for all majors (including concentrations) and certificates offered by the college. For programs available in an online format, an online program or accelerated online program has been included in the program name. A list of graduate courses and a glossary of terms is also included.
School of Medicine Catalog
The UTRGV School of Medicine Catalog provides information impacting students in the MD program including program requirements, course descriptions, and policies.
School of Podiatric Medicine Catalog
The UTRGV School of Podiatric Medicine Catalog provides information impacting students in the DPM program, including program requirements, course descriptions, and policies.
*Past issues of catalogs are located on the UTRGV catalog archive page.
